newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares down, Lisnave hits record low.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares down, Lisnave hits record low.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Portuguese shares ended lower, although they recovered from the day's lows late in the session. Turnover exceeded 11 billion escudos, above the recent daily average. Loss-making ship repairer Lisnave hit an all-time low of 245 escudos, down 42 percent from Friday, after its president Jose de Mello said in a television interview that the company was bankrupt. Rights in the restructuring of Sonae Investimentos hit a high of 677 escudos on the last day of trade. Dealers said exchange rate instability had unsettled the share market. The Lisbon market will closely watch remarks by U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan later in the week, dealers said.
